item.title: Comment on Come on guys, we are better than this! by Nikki Sirko
item.dc:creator: Nikki Sirko
item.description: A couple comments about the post: 1. Love it and absolutely agree. My school is a good example and our community always follows suit, good or bad. 2. Really with you Singapore guests? Really? 3. Unfortunately I think the other reason people leave trash on the floor is that they believe it’s not their job, not their problem. That, to me, is not ok.
item.content:encoded:
A couple comments about the post:
1. Love it and absolutely agree. My school is a good example and our community always follows suit, good or bad.
2. Really with you Singapore guests? Really? 🤦🏻‍♀️
3. Unfortunately I think the other reason people leave trash on the floor is that they believe it’s not their job, not their problem. That, to me, is not ok.
